page.overview:
Who is Aquastar?

Aquastar is a Swiss watch maker founded in 1962 by Frédéric Robert, a watchmaker, scuba diver, and skipper. Frederic Robert was the son of the 5th generation watchmaker family that founded the brand Jean Richard in the late 1800s.

Aquastar has become known for its specialized instruments and wrist watches designed for professional diving. A. A. to reflect its new focus.

entity.description: Aquastar is a Swiss watch maker founded in 1962 by Frédéric Robert, a watchmaker, scuba diver, and skipper. Frederic Robert was the son of the 5th generation watchmaker family that founded the brand Jean Richard in the late 1800s. Aquastar has become  known for its specialized instruments and wrist watches designed for professional diving. In 1962, the company Jeanrichard S.A. changed its name to Aquastar S.A. to reflect its new focus.
